meta.title: Blade, statistics and the work you repeat
meta.description: Ask in plain language. Blade runs your analysis in R, explains the result, and saves the steps as a workflow you can run again.
meta.ogTitle: Blade, statistics and the work you repeat
meta.ogDescription: Ask in plain language. Blade runs your analysis in R, explains the result, and saves the steps as a workflow you can run again.

hero.lede: Blade handles the heavy lifting, then saves the steps as a workflow you can run again next month.

workflows.title: Do the analysis once. Run it again next month
workflows.text: Save a finished session as a workflow: the goal, the R script that worked, and an example of the result. Next time, point it at new files.

steps.label: 01 / Capture
steps.title: A session becomes a workflow
steps.text: Blade saves the goal, the script that worked, and an example of the output.

steps.label: 02 / Repeat
steps.title: New files, same steps
steps.text: Run the workflow on this month's data. Blade adapts to small changes, like a renamed column.

steps.label: 03 / Share
steps.title: Hand the process on
steps.text: Export one .bladeworkflow file. Anyone with Blade can import it and run it.
